text:
Rajaji National Park is a national park and tiger reserve in the Haridwar, Dehradun and Pauri Garhwal districts of the Indian state of Uttarakhand. It encompasses an area of 820 km2 (320 sq mi) in the Sivalik Hills. In 1983, three wildlife sanctuaries in the area, namely Chilla, Motichur and Rajaji, were merged into one.

--- Practical Travel Context (Wikivoyage) ---
Dehradun (Hindi: देहरादून Dehrādūn) is the winter capital of the Indian state of Uttarakhand. Nestled between the Himalayan foothills to the north and the Shivaliks to the south, the town offers breathtaking scenery. It is a favourite destination among tourists, pilgrims and enthusiasts alike from different regions with its serene environment. Apart from this, there is an abundance of basmati rice, tea and lychee gardens.
best_time: March to June (pleasant summer flowers) and September to November (crisp autumn views)
